evidence.supports: Reports the July 21, 2026 City Council vote (6-1) adopting a 12-month moratorium, the accompanying emergency clause vote (6-1), and direct quotes from Councilman Brewer, Councilman Pendergraft, and Mayor Chad Allcox.
evidence.quote: Choctaw City Council approved a 12-month moratorium on data centers within the city limits July 21 allowing city leaders time to evaluate possible further restrictions on the construction of data centers... Both agenda items passed meaning the moratorium went into effect immediately.

evidence.supports: Independent September 2026 roundup corroborating the July 21, 2026 adoption date and July 2027 expiration, and expressly distinguishing this Choctaw (Oklahoma County) from the unrelated Choctaw County in southeast Oklahoma.
evidence.quote: Choctaw (Oklahoma County) | Twelve month pause on accepting data center applications. Council discussed an outright ban and chose the pause instead. No data center had submitted plans in the city... | Jul 21, 2026 | Jul 2027

decisions.notes: Verified against the Choctaw Times/Central Oklahoma Weeklies account (named reporter, direct council-member quotes): 6-1 adoption of a 12-month moratorium on July 21, 2026, with an accompanying 6-1 emergency-clause vote. Corroborated by an independent legal-roundup source. No duplicate; expressly distinguished from the unrelated Choctaw County in southeast Oklahoma.

evidence.supports: Reports the unanimous 7-0 vote, the sponsor (Commissioner Chris Odneal), the Dec. 31, 2027 end date, the extension from an initially proposed 90-day study period, and that the pause does not affect existing/under-construction projects.
evidence.quote: Shawnee city commissioners voted 7-0 on Monday to freeze new data center applications through the end of 2027... The measure was sponsored by Commissioner Chris Odneal... City staff had initially estimated a 90-day study period would be enough, but commissioners opted for a much longer runway, pushing the pause out to December 31, 2027...

evidence.supports: Independent corroboration of the moratorium taking effect immediately and running through the end of 2027.
evidence.quote: The city of Shawnee has approved a temporary moratorium on new data centers, putting new proposals on hold through the end of 2027... The moratorium takes effect immediately and will remain in place through the end of 2027.

evidence.supports: Confirms the exact Aug. 17, 2026 meeting date, the unanimous 7-0 vote, the resolution's sponsor, and staff's commitment to report findings within 90 days.
evidence.quote: The board approved a temporary moratorium on data centers until December 31, 2027, following public comment from residents concerned about utility impacts and the need for a public vote. The resolution, brought by Commissioner O'Neal, was supported by staff noting pending studies and no current applications, with a commitment to report findings within 90 days. The vote was unanimous at 7-0.

decisions.notes: Verified against two independent news accounts (Hoodline, News9) and a secondary meeting-summary aggregator, all consistent: unanimous 7-0 vote on Aug. 17, 2026, effective immediately, freezing new applications through Dec. 31, 2027. No duplicate.
